# Data dictionary

<!-- Generated by `make data-docs` from data/transform/models/**/_*.yml. Don't edit by hand. -->

The tables in every [data release](README.md). Column names and types are a contract: a release
never removes or retypes a column without saying so in its notes. The same descriptions are
attached to the tables when you `attach` the catalog in DuckDB (see `duckdb_columns()`).

## stg_usaspending__awards

USAspending.gov contract award summaries as published, typed and renamed, one row per award: DoD purchases of bearings (PSC group 31) with any activity from FY2023 onward. An award is a contract or order with its modifications rolled up, deduplicated across fiscal-year files. It records a commitment to buy, not a delivery, and usually names a kind of part rather than a specific one.

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `award_key` | varchar | USAspending's contract_award_unique_key. Stable across releases. |
| `piid` | varchar | Procurement instrument identifier (contract or order number). |
| `parent_piid` | varchar | Parent contract (IDV) for orders; null for standalone contracts. |
| `recipient_uei` | varchar | Supplier's SAM.gov Unique Entity ID. Use this, not the name, to identify suppliers. |
| `recipient_name` | varchar | Supplier name as reported; spelling varies across awards. |
| `recipient_parent_uei` | varchar | UEI of the supplier's corporate parent. |
| `recipient_parent_name` | varchar | Name of the supplier's corporate parent. |
| `cage_code` | varchar | Commercial and Government Entity code of the supplier. |
| `domestic_or_foreign_entity` | varchar | Ownership category, e.g. "U.S. OWNED BUSINESS", "FOREIGN-OWNED BUSINESS INCORPORATED IN THE U.S.". |
| `origin_country` | varchar | Country of origin of the product. |
| `psc` | varchar | Product and Service Code; 3110, 3120, or 3130. |
| `item_name` | varchar | Item name from the description, without DLA's leading reference number. Truncated, inconsistent spelling. |
| `nsn` | varchar | National Stock Number (13 digits) when the description contains one; under 1% of awards. |
| `description` | varchar | Original free-text description. |
| `dla_reference_number` | varchar | Leading 10-digit number in DLA descriptions. Unique per award; NOT an item identifier. |
| `awarding_sub_agency` | varchar | DoD component that made the award; mostly the Defense Logistics Agency. |
| `total_obligated_amount` | decimal(18,2) | Total dollars obligated, USD. |
| `base_action_date` | date | Date of the award's first action. |
| `extent_competed` | varchar | Competition category, e.g. "FULL AND OPEN COMPETITION", "NOT COMPETED". |
| `offers_received` | integer | Number of offers received. 1 suggests a sole source; null when not reported. |
| `other_than_full_and_open_reason` | varchar | Legal justification when the award was not fully competed. |
| `last_modified_at` | timestamp | When USAspending last changed the award; the newest version wins when files overlap. |
| `source_file` | varchar | Raw file the row came from (`<fiscal-year folder>/<csv>`), within the release's raw archive. |

## meta_build

One row describing the build that produced this release.

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `release_tag` | varchar | Release tag, e.g. `data-2026-10-04`. |
| `git_sha` | varchar | Git commit the release was built from. |
| `git_dirty` | boolean | True if the build included uncommitted changes. Published releases are always false. |
| `dbt_version` | varchar | dbt version that ran the transform. |
| `built_at` | timestamp with time zone | When the release was built. |

## meta_source_files

One row per raw file the release was built from, with its checksum and the request that fetched it.

| Column | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `source` | varchar | Source name, e.g. `usaspending`. |
| `snapshot` | varchar | Snapshot date (the raw directory name), e.g. `2026-10-04`. |
| `file` | varchar | Raw file name, as stored in the release's raw archive. |
| `sha256` | varchar | Checksum of the raw file. |
| `retrieved_at` | timestamp with time zone | When the file was downloaded. |
| `rows` | bigint | Rows the source reported for the file (for USAspending, prime awards + subawards). |
| `license` | varchar | License of the source data. |
| `request` | varchar | The exact API request (JSON) that produced the file. |
